item.name: Juicer
item.cardSummary: Juicer is the first Lemon Stand cash button. It doubles stand cash and is the usual first named plot upgrade after you start selling.

item.name: Cup Stand
item.cardSummary: Cup Stand triples Lemon Stand cash. Buy it on the starter plot after Juicer when you want a larger stand payout.

item.name: Billboard
